title: Climate migrants: Dominican Republic: Country Report
temporal_coverage: Climate-migration projections for 2050 and 2100; qualitative case-study interviews in Restauración reported in the 2024 country report.
methodology: Quantitative climate-migration modeling plus qualitative interviews in Restauración.
limitations: Projections are uncertain; interviews reflect one agricultural-border locality, not population prevalence.

title: Dominican Republic Poverty Assessment 2023: Background Note on Poverty and Climate Change
temporal_coverage: Uses a 2021 flood-risk household survey for reported impacts and coping in April 2019–April 2021, plus historical household and hazard data.
methodology: Uses a 2,057-household 2021 flood survey and risk maps.

title: Dominican Republic: 2025 Article IV Consultation—Press Release; Staff Report; and Statement by the Executive Director
temporal_coverage: 2025 Article IV report; reports recent policy and disaster conditions, including Hurricane Fiona in 2022 and climate projections to 2050.
methodology: Article IV report covers climate and disaster-risk policy.
limitations: WB source for some impacts; policy tools not evaluated.
